title: Shiny Pig/Message
wikitext:
<noinclude>
This message table is used on [[Shiny Pig]] and [[Shiny Orb]].
</noinclude>{| class="wikitable"
! Condition !! Message
|-
| On Interaction with a Shiny Pig of another player || {{Dialogue|&dOink! &eThis pig has already been clicked by someone else!}}
|-
| On Bringing a Shiny Pig to its Orb || {{Dialogue|&6&lSHINY! &eThe orb is charged! Click on it for loot!}}
|-
| On Clicking on a Shiny Orb charged by the player || {{Dialogue|&6&lSHINY! &eYou extracted &b[#]x &a[item] &efrom the pigglet's orb!}}
|-
| On Clicking on a Shiny Orb charged by another player || {{Dialogue|&cOnly the orb's owner may click on it!}}
|-
| When Shiny Pig is not brought to its Orb after 90 seconds || {{Dialogue|&cYour Shiny Orb and associated pig expired and disappeared.}}
|-
! Condition !! Message
|-
| On Interaction with Shiny Pig without holding a Shiny Orb || {{Dialogue|&dOink! &eUse a &6Shiny Orb &efrom the &dPig Shop &eto capture the shiny from this piggy!}}
|-
| On Interaction with Shiny Pig when holding a Shiny Orb when two other Shiny Pigs are active || {{Dialogue|&cYou may only "own" up to 2 shiny pigs at once.}}
|-
| On Interaction with Shiny Pig when holding a Shiny Orb otherwise || {{Dialogue|&dOink! &eBring the pig back to the &6Shiny Orb&e!}}
|}
